name: trace_thread_state
description: Retrieve thread state information from a Perfetto trace. Analyzes thread scheduling states (Running, Sleeping, etc.) during a specific time range. Find thread IDs first with run_sql_query: SELECT utid, name FROM thread. If session_id is omitted, uses the most recently captured trace.

end_ts.description: End time of the query in nanoseconds (default: very large)

session_id.description: The file name of the trace (session ID). If omitted, uses the most recently captured trace.

start_ts.description: Start time of the query in nanoseconds (default: 0)

utid.description: Unique thread identifier (utid) from Perfetto trace
